description: This file defines the 'CannotDeleteObjectInUseException' class, a specific exception used within the OpenMRS API to indicate an attempt to delete an object that is still in use or referenced elsewhere. It extends the 'InvalidOperationOnObjectException' class and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

classes.name: CannotDeleteObjectInUseException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that an object cannot be deleted because it is currently in use or referenced by other objects in the system. It extends 'InvalidOperationOnObjectException' and offers several constructors to specify detailed error information.

methods.name: CannotDeleteObjectInUseException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception with a specified detail message.

methods.name: CannotDeleteObjectInUseException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception with a specified detail message and underlying cause.

methods.name: CannotDeleteObjectInUseException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception with a message key and parameters for localization or message formatting.

methods.name: CannotDeleteObjectInUseException(Class clazz)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception indicating the class type of object involved in the delete operation.
